items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: They could always get a gig with Cass Carr. That's that they called him. He shortened his name from Casper Cowie(?) to Cass Carr.

ctx.x: he was quite a bandleader. He would get a lot of work. Just gig work. He didn't work anywhere steady or anything like that. He was just giggin'. And he had a nucleus to his band, which I don't remember... But he would always have openings for anybody that was giggin'. And that way, he used, oh, numerous musicians that was in the street giggin', lookin' for gigs and one-thing-or-another. They could always get a gig with Cass Carr. That's that they called him. He shortened his name from Casper Cowie(?) to Cass Carr.
Oh, it was Cowie(?), not Towey(?).

Well, I don't know what it was. But they called him Cass Carr. And he survived for years in the business. And he was a very good photographer. He went in for photography more than he was music. He was interested in taking pictures, and one-thing-or-another. And now, he's in the line of... He sells photographic instruments. He sells photographic instruments to professionals. He's got a place downtown somewhere. He's out of the music business altogether.
